summary: Exector is an action–shooter mech-based video game developed and published by Arc System Works for the PlayStation. It was released exclusively in Japan in 1995 and was the first original title by Arc System Works sold to the general public. In 2017 it was later digitally reissued as a PSOne Classic on PlayStation Portable (PSP), PlayStation 3, and PlayStation Vita.
